products.facts: Supplier title: Cat and Dog Mat - Cake Roll Cat Bed. Listing says it is designed for cats and small dogs, with a short plush exterior, plush sponge filling, 40 cm height, yellow color, and delivery in a mesh bag. Source images show a round, tunnel-style bed shaped like a roll cake, with a strawberry topper and a kiwi, strawberry and citrus pattern around the opening; a cat is resting inside. Pending supplier confirmation: diameter and length, weight limit, washing instructions, removable cover, exact pet size range and whether the interior lining differs from the exterior. No evidence for orthopedic, calming or temperature claims.

Supplier title: Waterproof High-Back Pet Bed for Dogs and Puppies. Listing says polyester, gray, waterproof, easy to clean, high-back design. Sizes listed: S 60x50xH37 cm, 1.83 kg; M 75x60xH39 cm, 2.23 kg; L 90x70xH41 cm, 3.3 kg; XL 120x90xH43 cm, 4.63 kg. Source image shows a golden retriever sleeping in a gray bolster bed with a soft light interior and raised back. Pending supplier confirmation: waterproof rating or which layer is waterproof, removable or machine-washable cover, filling material, recommended pet weight per size. No evidence for orthopedic or joint-support claims.

Supplier title: Pet Hair Comb Grooming Brush Effectively Remove Loose Hair Pet Cleaning Tool for Hair Removal and Bathing. No supplier description provided. Source image shows a fine-toothed pet comb in pastel green and yellow with a rounded handle and text reading 'One-touch self-cleaning opens a new combing experience' and 'Remove loose hair'. Pending supplier confirmation: dimensions, pin material and spacing, suitable coat types, how the release mechanism works, whether it can be used on wet fur and package contents. No evidence for shedding-reduction, skin-care or painless-grooming claims.

Supplier title: Portable Travel Water Bottle for Dogs and Cats. Listing says resin, 400 ml capacity, 27.1 x 6.5 cm, lightweight, colors gray, green, blue and pink. Source image shows a tall clear bottle with a gray top, a blue button and a carry loop. Pending supplier confirmation: how the drinking tray opens, leak resistance, food-contact suitability, whether a filter insert is included, cleaning instructions and package contents. No evidence for leak-proof, BPA-free or filtration claims.

Supplier title: Stainless Steel Pet Water Dispenser with Filtration. Listing says stainless steel, 2 L capacity, loop filter that circulates water, USB electrical outlet, 100 x 330 x 220 mm, 1.55 kg. Source image shows a silver oval bowl with a raised dome section, set on a woven rug. Pending supplier confirmation: pump specifications and noise level, filter type and replacement, power adapter and cord length, steel grade, dishwasher suitability and package contents. No evidence for water-purity or health claims.

Supplier title: Large Capacity Foldable Pet Trolley Backpack with Wheels. No supplier description provided. Source image shows a blue carrier with gray trim, an extendable pull handle, four wheels, mesh side panels, round ventilation holes, two front zip pockets and a gray top panel. Pending supplier confirmation: interior and folded dimensions, pet weight limit, materials, color options, how the backpack straps work, airline suitability and package contents. No evidence for airline-approved, safety-tested or anti-escape claims.

Supplier title: Winter Thickened Portable Pet Chest Backpack. Listing says nylon and cotton, medium-soft texture, five colors (pink, black, beige, grey, green), 43 cm length, 33 cm width, 506 g, adjustable straps. Source image shows quilted carriers in five colors and a person wearing one on the chest with a dog looking out. Pending supplier confirmation: recommended pet weight and size, padding material, leg opening sizes, closure details and package contents. No evidence for safety-tested or weight-limit claims.

Supplier title: Travel Car Cushion for Small to Medium Dogs. Listing says cloth, 55 x 50 x 30 cm, doubles as a dog bed, includes a safety buckle, colors blue stripes, coffee stripes and red stripes, 1.83 kg, delivered in compressed packaging. Source image shows a blue-and-white striped raised-sided seat on a car seat, with a strap at the back. Pending supplier confirmation: pet weight limit, how it attaches to the seat, washability, filling material and package contents. No evidence for crash-tested or safety-rated claims.

Supplier title: Waterproof and Snowproof Pet Shoes for Dogs. Listing says waterproof fabric, anti-slip Oxford bottom, reflective strap, black and blue colors, sizes XS to 2XL, described as wear-resistant. Source image shows a dog in snow wearing black boots with bright green cuffs. Pending supplier confirmation: size chart, closure type, insulation, sole thickness and whether a set of four is included. No evidence for paw-protection, warmth or injury-prevention claims.

Supplier title: Adjustable Wooden Pet Dog Ladder - Foldable Ramp. Listing says wood, wood color finish, foldable and portable, adjustable, non-slip surface, 3.12 kg. Source image shows a wooden ramp with a black textured surface leading down from a car door, with a small dog. The listed dimensions (100 cm height, 430 cm length, 320 cm width) are inconsistent with a portable ramp and are not used. Pending supplier confirmation: actual length, width, height settings, weight capacity, folded size and package contents. No evidence for joint-support or injury-prevention claims.
